title: Analysis code: integrative post-GWAS analyses nominate 11p11.2 as a candidate locus for Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy
description: Scripts, installation instructions, compatibility patches and checks that reproduce every table and figure of the article (TWAS with S-PrediXcan, S-MultiXcan and FUSION; colocalisation; fine-mapping; cis-Mendelian randomisation; cross-trait analyses of glaucoma, intraocular pressure and refractive error). Public inputs are downloaded by the pipeline and are not redistributed. See README.md.
